text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Daitaku Helios—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they've got "Paka Petit" here~! 
Trainy, wanna take a quick look?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Daitaku Helios 
pointed, there was a claw machine filled 
with plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I low-key love this kinda stuff! You can 
totally hang it on your phone and 
everything!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pama-chin and I won this ridiculously huge 
one before, and it wouldn't fit in the 
bag, we laughed so hard!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's give it another shot today! 
Cheer me on, Trainy-poyo☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios kept persisting for a 
while, but unfortunately couldn't win a 
single plushie.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I'm totally trash at 
crane games! It went past crying straight 
to hilarious! Ahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Trainer-pi, are you secretly hella 
confident about this!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice♪ I'm getting super hyped for 
this!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Show me what you got, Trainer-pi~~♪ Wanna 
see you do something cool! Grab it! Grab 
it! Show 'em how it's done~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
